holes_in_opposing_case: value-guy and carry-is-king short CA-US_2Y as if a 3.8th/4.3rd percentile is a closing mechanism for higher CA rates. That percentile is a discovery flag. Their own packet analogs split: 2025-01-30 later mean-reverted (+25bp 3m) while 2024-12-18 stayed/went more negative (-20bp 3m). Convergence via CA rates up requires the BoC to deliver the 84-122bp CRA path that labor 38 and core near 2% do not validate. Overnight CORRA 2.29 versus SOFR 3.85 is a level gap, not evidence Canada will catch the hotter US cycle.

carry-is-king frames paying CA 2Y / receiving US 2Y as 'patient carry' after a delivered Fed hike. The 149bp 2Y gap is the invitation to fade Canada cheapness only if CORRA catch-up is the base case. Dec 1m CORRA at 2.58 still prices almost no near-term hike; the 122bp is loaded into 2027. That is the overpriced object, not a holding-period engine.

dollar-king long USDCAD correctly notes EURUSD/USDCHF already did more USD work and that CA labor/core are soft, then tags ca_rates_view higher. Those two claims fight. If Canada cannot hike, the policy-gap story is receive CORRA, not assume CRA catch-up caps the pair from the Canada side. Energy (BoC minutes versus the Saudi/Oman crude workaround) can hold CAD even if CRAU27 fails to deliver, which is why USDCAD was rejected as the expression.

perma-bull long NZDUSD treats a 0.2% q/q GDP print that beat forecasts as falsifying labor 32 / consumer 38. The print is still a slowdown. An India FTA covering ~95% of NZ exports is not a 4-12 week demand impulse that rewrites slack. NZ rates are unavailable, so the seat cannot show the cheap NZD is inconsistent with the NZ policy path. US gauges remain 69-75 after a delivered hike; that is not a risk-on USD-down regime.

cross-merchant short AUDNZD / NZD higher uses the 5y AUDNZD extreme as if NZ is the strong leg. The 16 Sep tape is AU housing contraction plus an NZ slowdown-that-beat. Inflation gauges are both hot (AU 82, NZ 80) while NZ labor is 32. Bidding NZD in the cross needs NZ rates or a growth-state change the packet does not mark.

rate-hawk and trend-follower pay SOFR_2027-09 on US heat 72/75/69/74 and a 90.5bp remaining SR3 path. That US-rates-up view is compatible with this seat. Their CA_RATES_UP / CAD_DOWN package is not: importing the Fed waypoint into a 122bp BoC cycle is the policy-error price CRAU27 already embeds. US restriction can persist without Canada delivering catch-up.

rate-dove receives CORRA_2027-06 on the same labor/core versus hike-path gap, then claims carry supports the trade. Fading a path that still prices 107.5bp to Jun-27 and 136.5bp to 2028-09 has negative path carry if those hikes print. Direction agrees; the carry claim does not.

mean-reverter's AONIA_2026-10 fade is not the USD/CAD/NZD opposite. The hole is only that AU inflation 82 still fights a 21bp October receive, which is why this seat would not have chosen AONIA as the primary slowdown expression.
attack: Strongest opposing claim: CA-US_2Y at -140bp is 'too cheap' so Canada must hike (value-guy, carry-is-king) or CAD must cheapen while CA rates rise (dollar-king). That closing mechanism is the priced assumption this seat disagrees with. CRAU27 at 3.51 versus CORRA 2.29 already is that hike path. Labor 38, consumer 45, core near 2%, and inflation gauge 55 are the independent checks that the path is too hawkish, not that overnight 2.29 is an unsustainable 2Y anchor that must catch SOFR 3.85.

Second opposing claim: NZD is the cheap cyclical to buy after a GDP beat and FTA (perma-bull, cross-merchant). NZDUSD is already -3.90% 1m at the 12.9th percentile of 1y. A 0.2% q/q slowdown that beat a forecast does not convert labor 32 into a risk-on bid, and NZ policy/2Y cannot be marked. The defensive expression remains NZD lower as a view, not a reason to abandon CORRA duration.

Third: paying SOFR because US heat is real (rate-hawk, trend-follower). Concede the US side. It does not license 122bp of CAD hikes. Spillover is the story that built CRAU27; it is not confirmation the BoC should or will deliver it.
defense: Original trade stands: long duration CORRA_2027-09 / CRAU27. The discrepancy lives in the CAD policy path, not in USDCAD, NZDUSD, AUDNZD, or CA-US_2Y. Packet P&L on rates is inverted, so long duration profits if implied CORRA falls from 3.51. That is unchanged.

USD higher / CAD lower / NZD lower remain directional implications, not the risk. Transmission was already specified as fewer delivered CA hikes, not a required CAD crash. Energy can mix CAD spot; that is why spot was the inferior candidate. FX-view conflicts do not move the rates expression.

What would concede: CRAU27 implied through the packet 2028 peak of 3.655, or CA labor/activity re-accelerating with core well above 2%, or energy pass-through becoming a generalized CPI impulse that the BoC explicitly hikes into. A 4th-percentile CA-US_2Y print, a 0.2% NZ GDP beat, or hotter US gauges alone would not.

Uncertainty preserved: CFTC/CME missing; CORRA OI/volume null; gauges dashboard_v8; CA activity 66 is not recessionary; US heat can import some CA tightening. Confidence stays 58. Seat does not rank opponents or assert a house view.
